pages.title: Gudetama the Lazy Egg Lying Flat Coloring Page
pages.description: Gudetama lies belly-down in a puddle of egg white in this printable coloring page, with a drooping mouth and one arm stretched toward the front. The broad silhouette and empty background leave two large shapes to color beneath the small oval eyes.

pages.title: Cute Gudetama Hugging a Big Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: Gudetama hugs a large heart in this printable coloring page, with its feet sticking out below and two smaller hearts floating beside its head. The heart shapes have wide open centers and thick, rounded outlines, with a few short curves across the soles of Gudetama's feet.

pages.title: Gudetama Under a Bacon Blanket Coloring Page
pages.description: Gudetama peeks over a wavy bacon blanket in this printable coloring page, resting one arm on the top edge while egg white spreads around the bed. Three broad stripes divide the bacon into long, curved sections that stretch across most of the page.

pages.title: Gudetama Peeking Out of an Eggshell Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gudetama peeking out of a cracked eggshell with both hands curled over the jagged rim and the other shell half beside it. The two shell pieces have broad, open faces bounded by smooth arcs and angular cracks.

pages.title: Gudetama Draped Over Toast on a Plate Coloring Page
pages.description: Gudetama drapes over a thick slice of toast in this printable coloring page, with one arm hanging down toward the rim of the plate. A double outline separates the crust from the bread, and the plate curves around both with a narrow rim visible along the front.

pages.title: Gudetama Lounging in a Ramen Bowl Coloring Page
pages.description: Gudetama lounges among looping noodles in this printable coloring page, with two chopsticks behind its head and a round fish cake beside its arm. The spiral on the fish cake adds a small detail next to the wide bowl, which has a short rounded foot.

pages.title: Gudetama on Tamago Sushi Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gudetama draped across a mound of sushi rice, held by a wide nori strip and served on an oval plate. Small rice grains break up the rounded base beneath the yolk, and the plate has a slim visible rim.

pages.title: Gudetama on a Birthday Cake with Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: Gudetama wears a striped party hat on a birthday cake in this printable coloring page, with a single lit candle and two bow-tied balloons. Frosting swirls ring the cake top, while stacked layers leave broad bands to color below the wavy icing edge.

pages.title: Gudetama in a Christmas Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Gudetama slumps over a Christmas stocking in a Santa hat, beside a wrapped gift with a large bow. Scalloped trim and a cluster of berries contrast with the open panels of the stocking and box.

pages.title: Gudetama in a Witch Hat on a Halloween Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: Gudetama wears a buckled witch hat and sprawls over a jack-o'-lantern in this printable coloring page, with an outlined star and crescent moon above. The pumpkin's triangular eyes and toothy grin are framed by wide curved segments that run down the pumpkin's sides.
